name: Hasekura Youko
source:
Youko's always monitoring [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url]. She is very devoted to him, sometimes to the point of stalking him, but he for the most part ignores her. She used to be Taichi's first love, and is admired by him for being an almost complete person in his mind.

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
